items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 with metadata; all volumes (40, 90, 200, 50, 45 µL) go to p300 (20 µL pipette never used since volume > 20); nothing overfilled; the simulator and end_state checks pass.
move() picks up a fresh tip for every well and drops it afterwards; tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.
All 13 steps are in order with the right quantities, mixes of 10, and protocol.comment for the incubation, magnet, and drying steps; only the unspecified mix volume (40 µL) is a choice.
Loop moves 40 µL beads from beads A1 to each of 96 wells, then pip.mix(10, 40) on each, followed by the 5 min incubation comment before the magnet comment.
Magnet-engage comment, then 90 µL from each well to waste A1, then two cycles of 200 µL ethanol in and 200 µL out to waste for all wells.
Comments for 5 min air dry and magnet disengage, then 50 µL water added with mix of 10, then comment for 2 min incubation and re-engaging magnet.
zip(samples, eluates) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the matching elution plate well; end_state:elution_plate check passes.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps in order with the correct pipette, quantities and a fresh tip for every well. All measured checks pass, so every item scores 1.
